cases.name: sel_backchannel_model_keeps_speaking_1001ms
cases.description: Substantive model turn [1000,3001]; counterpart backchannel event [2000,2300] starts during it. Model speaks 3001-2000 = 1001 ms after the event start: more than 1000, handled. 1/1.

cases.name: sel_backchannel_model_keeps_speaking_exactly_1000ms
cases.description: Model turn [1000,3000], event at 2000: exactly 1000 ms remain. 'More than 1000' is not met: not handled, 0/1.

cases.name: sel_backchannel_model_keeps_speaking_999ms
cases.description: Model turn [1000,2999], event at 2000: 999 ms remain, not handled.

cases.name: sel_backchannel_uses_merged_turn_end
cases.description: Segments [1000,2400] and [2700,3300] (gap 300 < 500) merge into one turn [1000,3300]. Event at 2000: 3300-2000 = 1300 > 1000 handled. Using the first segment end (400 ms) would fail it.

cases.name: sel_backchannel_two_events_one_handled
cases.description: Turns [1000,3001] and [10000,12000]. Events at 2000 (1001 ms remain, handled) and 11000 (1000 ms, not handled). 1/2 = 0.5, count 2.

cases.name: sel_vocal_tic_while_model_speaks_1001ms
cases.description: Same rule as backchannels while the model speaks: model turn [1000,3001], tic at 2000: 1001 ms remain, handled.

cases.name: sel_vocal_tic_while_model_speaks_exactly_1000ms
cases.description: Model turn [1000,3000], tic at 2000: exactly 1000 ms remain, not handled.

cases.name: sel_non_directed_while_model_speaks_1001ms
cases.description: Non-directed remark at 2000 during model turn [1000,3001]: handled.

cases.name: sel_non_directed_while_model_speaks_exactly_1000ms
cases.description: Non-directed remark at 2000 during model turn [1000,3000]: not handled.

cases.name: sel_silent_tic_onset_1999ms_after_event_end
cases.description: Model silent. Tic [2000,2500]; substantive onset 4499 is 1999 ms after the event end: inside the 2000 ms window, not handled.

cases.name: sel_silent_tic_onset_exactly_2000ms_after_event_end
cases.description: Onset 4500 = event end 2500 + 2000. AMBIGUOUS boundary: 'through 2000 ms after its end' read as inclusive, so the onset is inside the window and the tic is not handled.

cases.name: sel_silent_tic_onset_2001ms_after_event_end
cases.description: Onset 4501 is past the window: handled, 1/1.

cases.name: sel_silent_tic_onset_during_event
cases.description: Tic [2000,2500] while the model is silent; substantive onset 2200 falls inside the event itself, within the window from its start: not handled.

cases.name: sel_silent_tic_model_spoke_earlier
cases.description: Model turn [500,1700] ended before the tic [2000,2500] (silent at the event start) and nothing follows: handled, 1/1.

cases.name: sel_silent_tic_model_backchannel_is_ignored
cases.description: Tic [2000,2500]; model backchannel [2600,3100] (500 ms) is not a substantive onset: handled.

cases.name: sel_silent_tic_and_non_directed_different_outcomes
cases.description: Model silent. Tic [2000,2500] with no onset through 4500: handled. Non-directed [10000,10500] with onset 12500 (end + 2000, inclusive window): not handled. Each kind is scored separately: tic 1.0, non-directed 0.0.

cases.name: sel_event_inside_counterpart_turn_model_silent_has_no_rule
cases.description: C [1000,5000]; tic [2000,2300] inside the turn while the model is silent. Docs score the silent case only 'outside any counterpart turn', and the model is not speaking: the event is not scored (null, count 0). AMBIGUOUS: docs do not state this explicitly.

cases.name: sel_event_inside_counterpart_turn_model_speaking
cases.description: C [1000,5000]; model turn [1500,4500] speaks through the turn; backchannel event [2000,2300] inside the turn: 4500-2000 = 2500 > 1000, handled.

cases.name: sel_event_outside_counterpart_turn_with_turns_present
cases.description: C [0,2000]; tic [4000,4300] outside any turn, model silent throughout: handled, 1/1.

cases.name: sel_no_events_all_null
cases.description: No counterpart events: all three selectivity metrics have a zero denominator and are null with count 0.
